policies.forbid_integrator_writes:
forbid(
  principal,
  action in [
    AgentCore::Action::"case___get_case",
    AgentCore::Action::"case___save_extraction",
    AgentCore::Action::"case___draft_action",
    AgentCore::Action::"actions___send_dispute_letter",
    AgentCore::Action::"actions___submit_fap_application",
    AgentCore::Action::"actions___request_itemized_bill",
    AgentCore::Action::"actions___file_escalation",
    AgentCore::Action::"actions___schedule_followup"
  ],
  resource == AgentCore::Gateway::"arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:gateway/cc-gateway"
)
when {
  principal.hasTag("role") &&
  principal.getTag("role") == "integrator"
};
